verses.1: A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
verses.2: O God, you are my God - for you I long! For you my body yearns; for you my soul thirsts, Like a land parched, lifeless, and without water.
verses.3: So I look to you in the sanctuary to see your power and glory.
verses.4: For your love is better than life; my lips offer you worship!
verses.5: I will bless you as long as I live; I will lift up my hands, calling on your name.
verses.6: My soul shall savor the rich banquet of praise, with joyous lips my mouth shall honor you!
verses.7: When I think of you upon my bed, through the night watches I will recall
verses.8: That you indeed are my help, and in the shadow of your wings I shout for joy.
verses.9: My soul clings fast to you; your right hand upholds me.
verses.10: But those who seek my life will come to ruin; they shall go down to the depths of the earth!
verses.11: They shall be handed over to the sword and become the prey of jackals!
verses.12: But the king shall rejoice in God; all who swear by the Lord shall exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut!

notes.text: For your love is better than life: only here in the Old Testament is anything prized above life - in this case God's love.
All who swear by the Lord: to swear by a particular god meant that one was a worshiper of that god (Isaiah 45:23; 48:1; Zephaniah 1:5).
